1.title: A Mastodon Tooth Is Discovered in a California Creek
1.summary: A researcher surveying a San Mateo County creek stumbled upon a preserved Pacific mastodon molar estimated to be at least 10,000 years old.

2.title: Republican Campaign Aide Is Fired Over Nazi Photo
2.summary: Senator Jon Husted, running in a high-stakes race in Ohio, dismissed his political director because of social media activity displaying a “complete lack” of judgment, a spokeswoman said.

3.title: Anthropic boss Dario Amodei calls for AI development to slow down
3.summary: The call comes amid growing concerns that AI models may become able to inflict serious damage worldwide.

4.title: Death Toll From Ferry Fire in the Philippines Rises to 76
4.summary: Rescuers were still searching for victims days after a fire broke out on the June Aster en route to a popular tourist site. At least 43 people survived.

5.title: Trump Says Irish Unification Would Be ‘Fantastic,’ Breaking With Precedent
5.summary: The United States has been officially neutral on an issue that was a source of decades of violence in Northern Ireland until a 1998 peace deal.

6.title: Iran Finds Escalation Is Fruitful Path to Leverage in War With U.S.
6.summary: Iran and its allies now hold sway over two key oil shipping routes, and Tehran is setting the stage for a diplomatic win that could enhance its stature.
